description: A two-storey brick works with the ground floor knocked through into one long room and every window along it propped open on a stick, because the room needs the air. Through them: benches, racks of odd plates, and a ring with its ropes taped where they've split. IRONSIDE GYM is painted across the brick over the door in letters a yard high. The road runs off to the east.
name: Ironside Gym
